title: The Ethics of Al Ethics: An Evaluation of Guidelines
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its findings are focused on the ineffectiveness of AI ethics guidelines, the gap between principles and practice, and omissions in current ethical discourse (e.g., hidden costs, lack of diversity, political abuse).
